name: Media Hub
description: Turn an article brief into a ready-to-publish image package -- featured image plus inline supporting images, with alt text -- using your own Magnific API key. Supports multiple AI image models (Magnific Mystic, Google Imagen 4 Fast/Ultra, Google Gemini 2.5 Flash) plus an automatic 'auto' model picker that matches the model to the image's role and prompt.

tools.name: create_media_brief
tools.description: Create a new image brief for an article: site, title, summary and how many inline images besides the featured image. Creates the package in draft status -- call generate_media_package next to actually produce the images.

site.description: Which site this article is for, e.g. 'g4s.md'. Free text -- used for filtering, not validated against a connected-sites list.
site.title: Site

summary.description: Short summary of the article's content/angle -- used as the basis for the image prompt(s).
summary.title: Summary

style_direction.description: Optional style guidance, e.g. 'industrial, realistic, no text in image, blue/grey palette'.
style_direction.title: Style Direction

inline_count.description: How many inline supporting images besides the featured image (0-8).
inline_count.title: Inline Count

model.description: Which model to use for every asset in this brief. Options: a Mystic style ('realism', 'fluid', 'zen', 'flexible', 'super_real', 'editorial_portraits'), a specific model ('mystic', 'imagen4-fast', 'imagen4-ultra', 'gemini-2.5-flash'), or 'auto' to let Media Hub automatically pick the best model per image role and prompt -- same idea as Magnific's own web app 'Auto' option. Omit entirely for Mystic's own default (unchanged v1 behaviour).
model.title: Model

MediaAsset.description: One image within a package -- featured or one of the inline slots.
MediaAsset.title: MediaAsset

return_schema.description: A brief plus its generated (or in-progress) image assets.
return_schema.title: MediaPackage

tools.name: generate_media_package
tools.description: Generate all pending images for a media package via Magnific (Mystic). Runs in the background -- you get an immediate acknowledgement, then a follow-up message when the images are ready (or on failure).

package_id.description: The media package to generate images for. Get this from create_media_brief or list_media_packages.
package_id.title: Package Id

MediaAsset.description: One image within a package -- featured or one of the inline slots.
MediaAsset.title: MediaAsset

return_schema.description: A brief plus its generated (or in-progress) image assets.
return_schema.title: MediaPackage

tools.name: list_media_packages
tools.description: List media packages, optionally filtered by site or status.

site.description: Filter by site. Omit to list all.
site.title: Site

status.description: Filter by status: draft, generating, ready, failed. Omit for all statuses.
status.title: Status

MediaAsset.description: One image within a package -- featured or one of the inline slots.
MediaAsset.title: MediaAsset

return_schema.description: A brief plus its generated (or in-progress) image assets.
return_schema.title: MediaPackage

tools.name: get_media_package
tools.description: Get one media package in full, including every asset's status, image URL, alt text and caption.

MediaAsset.description: One image within a package -- featured or one of the inline slots.
MediaAsset.title: MediaAsset

return_schema.description: A brief plus its generated (or in-progress) image assets.
return_schema.title: MediaPackage

tools.name: regenerate_asset
tools.description: Re-generate a single image within a package (e.g. just the featured image) without touching the other assets. Optionally override the prompt for this one image.

role.description: Which asset to regenerate, e.g. 'featured' or 'inline_1'. Get valid roles from get_media_package.
role.title: Role

prompt_override.description: Optional replacement prompt for just this asset. Omit to reuse the brief's original prompt for this role.
prompt_override.title: Prompt Override

model.description: Optional model override for just this asset. Same vocabulary as create_media_brief's model field (Mystic style, a specific model id, or 'auto'). Omit to reuse the package's model (or Mystic's default).
model.title: Model

return_schema.description: One image within a package -- featured or one of the inline slots.
return_schema.title: MediaAsset

tools.name: update_asset_meta
tools.description: Edit the alt text and/or caption of one asset within a media package, without regenerating the image itself.

alt_text.description: New alt text. Omit to keep unchanged.
alt_text.title: Alt Text

caption.description: New caption. Omit to keep unchanged.
caption.title: Caption

return_schema.description: One image within a package -- featured or one of the inline slots.
return_schema.title: MediaAsset

tools.name: delete_media_package
tools.description: Permanently delete a media package and all of its asset records. Does not delete images already hosted on Magnific's own servers -- only the package record inside Media Hub.

package_id.description: The media package id to delete.
package_id.title: Package Id

return_schema.description: Outcome of a delete, phrased so the narrator can state what changed.
return_schema.title: DeleteResult

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List every image-generation provider Media Hub knows about, and whether each one is connected for this user.

params_schema.description:
Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers, so
even a tool with nothing to configure needs a typed (if empty) model.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: connect_magnific
tools.description: Connect Magnific by saving your API key, after checking it actually works. Get a key from magnific.com: User menu -> Organization Settings -> API Keys (requires a Business or Enterprise plan).

api_key.description: Magnific API key to validate and save for this user.
api_key.title: Api Key

tools.name: disconnect_magnific
tools.description: Disconnect Magnific: deletes the saved API key. Existing media packages and their already-generated images are kept -- only new generation is blocked until you connect again.

params_schema.description:
Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers, so
even a tool with nothing to configure needs a typed (if empty) model.
params_schema.title: NoParams

secrets.name: magnific_api_key
secrets.description: Your Magnific API key -- Magnific dashboard -> Organization Settings -> API Keys -> Create API key. Requires a Business or Enterprise Magnific plan.

secrets.name: magnific_webhook_secret
secrets.description: Webhook signing secret shown alongside your Magnific API key. Stored for future use -- v1 polls task status instead of relying on inbound webhooks, so this is not read by any handler yet.
